short: Assemble windowed cohomology bounds by cases

statements.markdown: One theorem assembles Statement 8.1 (of_four_alt). Its hy- potheses are a record of statements from the literature, the crude bound LemmaK below, and four counting statements (CountI, CountII, CountIII, CountV), each of which bounds the contribution of one class of pairs (ℓ, e); its proof calls, besides these, the theorem of Ferrero and Washington and the bound for the odd part.

lean.name: UpperTheory.V.HV.Core.of_four_alt
lean.plain: Assemble windowed cohomology bounds by cases
lean.note: `of_four_alt` takes the literature record, `LemmaK`, and `CountI`, `CountII`, `CountIII`, `CountV`. The proof supplies the `ThmBab` input using Ferrero–Washington, converts `ML.iv` to the required odd bound, and supplies `CountZ` before calling `vwin_of_counts`. The conclusion is VWin. Its proof combines four count bounds with the even and odd cohomological inputs.
